primitives.name: filter_by_slider
primitives.description: Narrow results with a range slider.

guide.summary: Narrow down search or listing results by adjusting a range slider to a specific value and applying the filter.

sections.title: Preconditions
items: The browser is on a page displaying a list of items (e.g., products, events, jobs).
A filter panel or section containing a range slider (such as price, rating, or salary) is visible.

sections.title: Steps
items: Locate the target range slider control on the page.
Click and drag the slider handle (or click at points along the slider track) until the associated numerical label displays the desired target value.
Click the 'Apply', 'Filter', or equivalent submission button to update the results.

sections.title: Watch for
items: The text label near the slider updating in real-time to reflect the current value as you drag.
A loading spinner or temporary overlay indicating the results are updating.

sections.title: Pitfalls
items: Dragging too quickly and releasing on the wrong value; use fine mouse movements or keyboard arrow keys if supported to dial in the exact number.
Forgetting to click the 'Apply' button after adjusting the slider, leaving the unfiltered results on screen.

sections.title: Variants
items: **The slider is linked to a text input box** — Type the target value directly into the input box instead of dragging the slider.
**There is no 'Apply' button** — Release the slider handle to let the page automatically refresh and apply the filter.

sections.title: Done when
sections.text: The list of results updates to reflect the filtered range, or the page URL changes to include the new filter parameters.

primitives.description: Sign a document by DRAWING your signature freeform on a canvas (“Sign here” field).
span: start drawing in the signature field

guide.summary: Sign a document or note by drawing a freeform signature on an interactive canvas and adopting/saving it.

sections.title: Preconditions
items: A signature pad, drawing canvas, or document signing area is visible on the screen.
The 'Draw' option is selected if there are multiple signing modes (e.g., Draw vs. Type).

sections.title: Steps
items: Locate the signature canvas area, often marked with an 'X', 'Sign here', or 'Draw your signature'.
Click and drag your mouse cursor across the canvas to draw the first stroke of your signature.
Release the mouse button, reposition the cursor, and click-and-drag again to complete subsequent strokes of the signature.
Review the drawn signature to ensure it is legible and correctly placed.
Locate and click the submission button, typically labeled 'Adopt and Sign', 'Adopt & Sign', or 'Save'.

sections.title: Watch for
items: Blue or black ink lines appearing on the canvas corresponding to your mouse drags.
The 'Adopt and Sign' button becoming active or highlighted after drawing.

sections.title: Pitfalls
items: Accidentally clicking the 'Clear' button instead of 'Adopt and Sign'.
Failing to release the mouse button between distinct letters, resulting in a single continuous line.
Attempting to type in a field that requires a drawn signature.

sections.title: Variants
items: **The interface defaults to typing or another input method** — Click the 'Draw' tab or button above the signature area before drawing.
**A mistake is made during drawing** — Click the 'Clear' button near the canvas to reset the drawing area and start over.

sections.title: Done when
sections.text: The signature modal closes, the document status updates to 'Signed', or the signature is permanently rendered on the document.

items: **the answer is spread across multiple sections or requires scrolling** — scroll through the page to read and compile all necessary parts of the answer before reporting
**the answer is a specific number or count** — visually count the matching items on the screen or read the total count directly from the UI

sections.title: Done when
sections.text: The final answer is submitted or reported to the user.
